lessons.title: Daily Work Life

items.example: Ich gehe jeden Tag zum Arbeitsplatz.
items.exampleMeaning: I go to the workplace every day.

items.example: Ich arbeite von neun bis fünf.
items.exampleMeaning: I work from nine to five.

lessons.tip: In German, nouns are always capitalized. Remember to use the correct article: der (masculine), die (feminine), das (neuter).

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Do you have a nice colleague?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ja, mein Kollege ist sehr nett.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, my colleague is very nice.

scenario.partnerRole: A is a colleague asking about the learner's work.
scenario.learnerRole: B is the learner sharing information about their job.
scenario.brief: Ask simple questions about the workplace, colleagues, and meetings. Use the new words from this lesson.
scenario.goal: You need to talk about your work situation.

lessons.title: Daily Tasks

items.example: Ich habe einen Termin um drei Uhr.
items.exampleMeaning: I have an appointment at three o'clock.

items.example: Das Meeting beginnt um zehn Uhr.
items.exampleMeaning: The meeting starts at ten o'clock.

lessons.tip: Remember to use the correct gender for nouns: die for feminine, der for masculine, and das for neuter. This affects articles and adjectives too.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: When do you have an appointment?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ich habe einen Termin um drei Uhr.
dialogue.meaning: I have an appointment at three o'clock.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I am writing an email.

scenario.partnerRole: A is asking about the learner's daily tasks.
scenario.learnerRole: B is the learner explaining their work tasks.
scenario.brief: Ask questions about tasks, meetings, and appointments. Use the new words from this lesson.
scenario.goal: You need to describe your daily work activities.

lessons.title: Office Equipment

items.exampleMeaning: I am looking for the file.

items.example: Ich mache Notizen während der Besprechung.
items.exampleMeaning: I take notes during the meeting.

lessons.tip: When describing objects, remember to use the correct article: der for masculine, die for feminine, and das for neuter. This will help with clarity.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Was ist dein Lieblingsgerät im Büro?
dialogue.meaning: What is your favorite device in the office?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: No, the printer does not work.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ja, ich mache Notizen während der Besprechung.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I take notes during the meeting.

scenario.partnerRole: A is a coworker discussing office equipment.
scenario.learnerRole: B is the learner talking about their office.
scenario.brief: Ask about equipment and tasks in the office. Use the new words from this lesson.
scenario.goal: You need to talk about office equipment and how you use it.

lessons.title: Planning and Meetings

items.example: Wir haben einen Plan für das Projekt.
items.exampleMeaning: We have a plan for the project.

items.example: Ich nehme an der Besprechung teil.

lessons.tip: Use the verb 'besprechen' to indicate that you are discussing something. It is a separable verb, so the prefix 'be-' is separated in the sentence.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hast du einen Plan für das Projekt?
dialogue.meaning: Do you have a plan for the project?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ja, ich bereite die Präsentation vor.

scenario.partnerRole: A is a team member discussing project plans.
scenario.learnerRole: B is the learner contributing ideas.
scenario.brief: Ask about plans and ideas for the project. Use the new words from this lesson.
scenario.goal: You need to share your ideas and plans.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Mein Arbeitsplatz ist gut. Ich arbeite von neun bis fünf.
dialogue.meaning: My workplace is good. I work from nine to five.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Do you have a nice colleague?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ja, mein Kollege ist sehr freundlich.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, my colleague is very friendly.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Die Besprechung ist morgen um zehn Uhr.
dialogue.meaning: The meeting is tomorrow at ten o'clock.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Was ist dein Plan für das Projekt?
dialogue.meaning: What is your plan for the project?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ich habe einen Plan und eine gute Idee.
dialogue.meaning: I have a plan and a good idea.

scenario.partnerRole: A is a colleague checking in on the learner's work.
scenario.learnerRole: B is the learner sharing their work situation.
scenario.brief: Discuss your workplace, colleagues, tasks, and plans. Use the vocabulary from the chapter.
scenario.goal: You need to summarize your work experience.
